title: Limit meta-analysis in the browser: validation against the R package metasens
description: DL + beta0 validation: 55,524 of 55,525 checks pass; one documented R non-convergence. Source 4a053dd (PR #115); button e431057 (PR #117); allmeta v1.4.0. Layer 1.1.0 (local, unreleased) adds the leave-one-out limit tier (allmeta 9b232cc: 31,514/31,514 node replay checks; full R regeneration) and the bias-sensitivity tier of allmeta v1.7.0 (16,097 checks: 15,928 numerical replayed in node + 169 archived browser render checks; full R regeneration). Page and tier files re-pinned to allmeta v1.8.0 (10.5281/zenodo.23515177, tag commit 1cb3f84); the page capture repeated on those bytes is byte-identical and both node replays give the same counts (RELEASE_EQUIVALENCE.md).
